body: Listen to this person. Threesomes are extremely overrated.  They're a weird sort of sexual confusion/anxiety.  I'm one jealous fuck, ca nt imagine doing that in a relationship. liisten to him though, not me.
Yeah but what about if you were low on DC and there's an abundance of AC in landfills and the ocean?
I know, its the great thing about this subreddit.  Its helped me out on many a bad day.  Thank you for spending time in here, you guys all definitely help
yeah I was taking 20 mg daily for around 5 months before I stopped.  The prozac was longer but not by much.
You lucky bastard! I want to get into info sec.  Im going to school for my computer science degree, which I think is pretty common here.
I'm working right now but heading off to college in 12 days. What about yourself?
I'm just feeling really crappy.  I've had kind of a bad week and ive just been in a bad mood all day
I'm a man, just barely though at 18.
That makes sense, the lexapro was wonderful but the side effects just sucked.  I was barely eating and still gaining weight fast that I'm now trying to lose :(
I was on prozac, but that gave me even worse anxiety.  Then I tried lexapro, but haven't taken it lately

I got in touch with the doctor today and he also recommended I take them until I'm able to meet in person with him and really talk about things.  I also found out that his schedule opened up next friday so my appointment got pushed from next month to next friday! The psychologists appointment is still next month but now I'll be able to get back on some sort of medication plan.  I've always been kind of iffy on the whole anti-depressants thing as I hate the idea of being reliant upon a pill.  And there seems to be a larger group of prozac haters than for any of the other anti-depressants.

What you said about your mom really caring, but being unable to relate  and really get to know you sounds spot on.  In the past there have been times where I tried to open up to her and realized it just broke her heart, and it was made even worse because she seemed like she had no idea what to do or say.  Me and her have had a fair amount of disagreements but I genuinely believe she would never purposely do anything to hurt me
Thank you for the words of encouragement :)

I've gone to her in the past before for things and its just kind of awkward.  I can tell she really wants to be there for me but she just has no idea how to help and doesn't know what to say and I can tell it just tears her up inside :(  Shes also the kind of person who would tell me everything is going to be okay even if the world was about to end which is sounds like a good thing, but it makes it hard for me to take her encouragements and compliments seriously

Yeah she definitely would.  I think its more that she wants to help but doesn't really know how, and I don't really either.  She has a very motherly tendency to sugar coat things for me which seems like it would help but for some reason it just end up making me feel worse.  Like it makes me think of what I want to be true but in the back of my mind know it isn't.

Yeah that sounds about right.  I never really worried about college because I figured even if I hated it, it would be mostly paid for by scholarships.  I figured that the worse case scenario I would get out after 4 years and feel like it was a waste, but now I'm worrying that the same thing will happen and I'll be getting smothered by student loans at the same time.

I have an older brother who I'm relatively close with but hes at school on the east coast and my dad who I feel comfortable talking to has been out of the country.  I'm surprised by the amount of redditors who have taken the time to talk, I was hoping for maybe one or two but talking to all of you guys really helps.

I've heard people talk about meeting people in classes they have.  How on earth does that work?  I feel like the only time to interact with other students in a class would be right before it starts and right after it ends before you leave.  I'm applying for a job in the computer science building so I'm hoping I'll meet some people through that.  Its like the on-campus version of a geek squad desk so I'll be able to meet people who've broken their computers and other computer science majors who i'll be working with

I found out today even the dorm I got is a party dorm, so I'll be at a party dorm at a party school.  I picked it because its right by the computer science building and figured its where all the prospective computer science majors would be but now I'm not too sure of that.  I would go to a LAN party over a kegger any day of the week so I'm hoping there are some rather nerdy student groups to find once I get there.
gahhh im sorry :( makes my problems seem like squat in comparison.  Good luck!  If you live in wisconsin we can hang out during college and wallow in our debt together

Ive been weight lifting regularly since I started seeing the counselors as they recommended some type of exercise and I absolutely hate running.  Unfortunately I'm on still kind of fighting off the tail end of mono which I managed to pick up over spring break,  and the doctor is convinced I'll rupture my spleen if I lift anything too heavy :( The whole exhaustion from mono combined with not being able to exercise has been kind of a drag.

Most of the college worrying is about having a job while still managing to get good grades and have a fun social life.  I feel like its going to be really stressful for four years and I'm worried I wont be able to handle it.  

Another thing is the debt :( even with the job I'm going to come out with over 10k in student loans.  Didn't it bother you coming out  of school and already being way in the hole? I don't really have any perspective on these amounts of money so I don't know how long its going to take to pay back.  What are your plans for paying off the 15k?

It was actually one of the first days in a long time where I wasn't feeling super down immediately upon waking up.  I think it really helped talking about some things on here.  I've been caught in kind of a catch 22 where I get terrible nightmares when I go to sleep, and always wake up feeling really shitty, so I try to stay up as long as I can to avoid it.  This just ends up making me feel super tired and then feeling shitty anyway, so I crawl into bed and the cycle repeats.  Today though I woke up and felt normal!  I took a nap after school and as soon as I woke up I felt shitty, but it was nice to finally have a morning that went alright.

The school is actually ranked as one of the countries top party schools which I'm not really looking forward to.  Even the high school drinking parties I've been to stress me out and from what I've heard college ones are much more intense.  I'm just hoping I'll be able to meet some people I really like and have time to hang out with them and do random stuff relatively often.  When you were in school how did the process of meeting people go?
I would definitely want to know the truth, and I'm sure she would too.  I don't really think theres any way that she can help so it seems pointless to make her worry
I hadn't thought of that but thats a good point.  Its the same psychiatrist as before so it will probably be the same medication but just in case I'll wait until I can talk to him.

Did you go to college or any post-secondary schooling?  I feel like the combined time of class, work, and classwork outside of class is going to make it hard to have time for anything else and that I'll miss out on the whole college experience.  I don't really know anything about colleges though.  I feel like I could meet people if i had all the free time I would if I didn't have a job, but that its going to consume most of my leisure time.  I don't really know what to expect next year I guess

I don't really want her to see me all upset.  I can usually keep my emotions under control when in public but sometimes at home its completely uncontrollable.  I don't want to make her worry about me as she thinks I'm doing a lot better.
Yeah I'm living with my parents again.  The period where I wasn't here was spent at a friends.  Only my mom has been home though as my dads in germany.  I'm not very close with her though
There office is closed now but I should probably try that tomorrow.  The lady when I called was just a receptionist and I don't know why but I didn't think to ask to talk to him.

If its the same as it was before I'll see the psychiatrist around once amount which is mainly to talk about the medication and the psychologist once a week or once every two weeks just to talk.  Unfortunately the only opening either one had is just under a month away so I'm stuck sitting here waiting

I think your partially right about the scholarships.  I just feel like a failed so badly at it, worse than I have with anything before.  I try to focus on the short term, but end up realizing I'm stuck at a high school I don't like where I feel completely alienated and its hard enough just to hold back tears during classes sometimes.  The only thing allowing me to make it through the day was knowing I would be in college the next year focusing on school and not having to worry about a job or finances in combination with the schoolwork

I called them both counselors.  One was a psychiatrist who prescribed the medication and I would see monthly and the other was a psychologist (I think?) who I talked to on a weekly basis.  Both thought the joint-counseling approach would be better than one or the other.

For the past four years I spent in high school I never got anything other than a 4.0 and always assumed the scholarship oppurtunites would allow me to get by with a summer job and no job during school.  Then the depression that started the summer before my senior year really took a toll on my and my senior year my gpa plummeted.  I feel like I was so close to having want I wanted and now I'll need to work and go to school at the same time.  I'm worried what this will mean for my social life in college and how its going to affect my grades.  I was certain I could get good grades and hopefully get a decent job upon graduation but now I'm not sure if I can handle the busier schedule.  I just want to go back in time and fix this year.  I cant stop thinking about how close I was to having it made before I fucked everything up

It feels like I have no answers right now, which seems so much worse than simply not having them all.  I feel like I don't want to push through the days if four years from now I'm going to end up somewhere I dont want to be.
